slots_and_copies.name: global_header
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Always loaded and validated first (signature + header checksum in FUN_08019364/FUN_080192c8); contains the per-slot checksum table, the 1M2A signature, one mutated payload byte at 0x68, and two boot-restored flag bytes at 0x76-0x77. Single copy, no backup.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Independent slot; validated by its own sum16 stored at header offset 0x00 (FUN_080192c8). No mirroring or fallback: a single invalid slot triggers a full factory reset of all slots (FUN_08019420).

slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Independent slot; validated by its own sum16 stored at header offset 0x02 (FUN_080192c8). No mirroring or fallback.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_2
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Independent slot; validated by its own sum16 stored at header offset 0x04 (FUN_080192c8). No mirroring or fallback.

slots_and_copies.name: unused_tail
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Never read or written by any traced function (used image is exactly 0x138 bytes: FUN_080192c8 reads 0x138, FUN_08019420 writes 0x138, FUN_080192a0 writes 0x78). Erased 0xFF in both samples.

checksums.name: header_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: Additive sum16 (FUN_080193b4: acc = (acc + (ushort)byte) mod 2^16, no seed/complement/XOR) over header bytes 0x00..0x77 (0x78 bytes) with the stored field bytes 0x06..0x07 treated as zero; stored big-endian at 0x06 (bytes [sum>>8, sum&0xFF]; RAM-side store is a native u16, byte swap attributed to the MSB-first EEPROM bitstream serialization). Covers the slot-checksum table, so it also protects offsets 0x00..0x05.

checksums.name: slot0_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: Same sum16 primitive (FUN_080193b4) over slot block 0x78..0xB7; stored big-endian at header 0x00. Write-side length is 0x40 (FUN_080193e0), load-side validation length is 0x3C (FUN_080192c8); samples cannot distinguish because slot bytes +0x3C..+0x3F are zero.

checksums.name: slot1_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: Same sum16 primitive over slot block 0xB8..0xF7; stored big-endian at header 0x02. Same 0x40-write / 0x3C-load length note as slot0_sum16.

checksums.name: slot2_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: Same sum16 primitive over slot block 0xF8..0x137; stored big-endian at header 0x04. Same 0x40-write / 0x3C-load length note as slot0_sum16.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 transfer primitive: programs DMA source/dest/count (count | 0x80000000 enable) via literal-pool globals (register block semantics match DMA3 at 0x040000D4) and polls the 0x8000 busy bit. Used for both EEPROM directions.

EEPROM read one 8-byte block: builds serial start+address bitstream (address width from EEPROM info struct byte +8, block count limit from u16 +4 = 64 blocks), DMAs command out and 0x44 halfwords back, unpacks 64 bits MSB-first into 4 u16s stored descending from dst+6.
Thin wrapper: tail-calls FUN_080373c8(block, buffer, 1) for an EEPROM block write.

EEPROM write one 8-byte block: packs 4 u16s bit-by-bit into a serial bitstream with address and start/stop bits (length addr_bits + 0x43), DMAs it to the EEPROM window via FUN_08037274, then polls status with a bounded (0x88) timeout.
EEPROM verify: re-reads a block via FUN_080372f4 into a stack buffer and compares 4 u16s; returns 0 on match, 0x8000 on mismatch. Provides read-back verification after both reads and writes.

EEPROM read N bytes (dst, length): length>>3 blocks, EWRAM staging buffer via FUN_0801f474/FUN_0801f550, per-block FUN_080372f4 read + FUN_08037558 verify, then byte-copy to the save struct. Called with length 0x138.

EEPROM write N bytes (src, start_offset, length): block indices via >>3, zeroed EWRAM staging buffer, per-block FUN_080373b4 write + FUN_08037558 verify. The only EEPROM-write primitive; its only call sites write 0x78 (header) or 0x138 (full image) at offset 0.
sum16 primitive: short acc; loop acc += (ushort)(byte)ptr[i] for i < (len & 0xFFFF). No seed, complement, or XOR.
Recompute+store header checksum: zeroes stored u16, stores FUN_080193b4(base, 0x78). File-verified stored offset 0x06, covered 0x00..0x77.
Recompute+store one slot checksum: FUN_080193b4(slot, 0x40) stored into header table at slot*2 (file offsets 0x00/0x02/0x04, big-endian in file).

Header validation: 4-byte signature compare (code struct offset +0x68; file magic at +0x6C) against a reference buffer, then stored-vs-recomputed header sum16 with the field zeroed. Returns 1 = invalid.

Load & validate entry: EEPROM config select (FUN_08021fa4), read 0x138 bytes (FUN_08021fb4), header validation (FUN_08019364), then per-slot sum16 validation over 0x3C bytes vs table at header +0/+2/+4. Any failure -> factory reset FUN_08019420.

Factory reset & full flush: zero 0x78 header, copy 4-byte signature, set flag bytes 0xFF, init 3 slots (FUN_080190d4/FUN_08019078), store slot checksums (FUN_080193e0) and header checksum (FUN_08019404), write 0x138 bytes (FUN_080220c0). Produces blank saves identical in structure to both samples; matches the pack mutation-probe behavior.

Header-only flush: FUN_08019404 then FUN_080220c0(base, 0, 0x78), returns write success. NO caller in callgraph.json and no textual caller in decompiled.c (presumed unrecovered indirect/tail jump); the only plausible settings/global-data save path.

Slot initializer: writes slot-index byte (code +0x18), zeroes first u32, copies two default u32s from a table into slot +12/+16, memsets slot +28..+59 and two globals; delegates to FUN_08019078. Its writes are erased by FUN_08019078 in the reset path.
Slot sub-initializer: memset first 0x3C slot bytes to zero, store marker 0x20 (code offset +0x19; file offset slot+0x1E, the only non-zero slot byte in both samples), memset a 0x20-byte global.
Boot save bootstrap: FUN_080190d4(working_slot, 0), FUN_080192c8 load/validate, then copies header flag bytes (code +0x70/+0x71; file 0x76/0x77) into two 1-byte globals.
EEPROM identify/config: calls FUN_0803722c(4), which selects the EEPROM geometry struct (block count + address-bit width) used by the block drivers.

fields.name: slot0_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Recomputed as sum16 over the slot block on factory reset (FUN_08019420 -> FUN_080193e0); stored big-endian in the file (native u16 in RAM, swap attributed to EEPROM serialization); also covered by the header checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_080193b4/FUN_080193e0 in decompiled.c; Python sum of slot block = 0x0020 matches stored BE16 on both files.

fields.name: slot1_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Same as slot0_checksum, for slot block at 0xB8.
fields.evidence: Same code path; Python verification on both files.

fields.name: slot2_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Same as slot0_checksum, for slot block at 0xF8.
fields.evidence: Same code path; Python verification on both files.

fields.name: header_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_08019404 zeroes the field, sums header 0x00..0x77 with FUN_080193b4, stores the result (big-endian in file). Recomputed on every flush (FUN_080192a0 header flush and FUN_08019420 reset). Delta between samples (+171) exactly equals the payload delta at offset 0x68.
fields.evidence: FUN_080193b4/FUN_08019404/FUN_08019364 in decompiled.c; Python computed 0x034f/0x03fa matches stored on both files; pack mutation probe at offset 0x7 (low byte of this field) caused blank reset.

fields.name: header_reserved_0x08_0x67
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed by factory-reset memset (FUN_08019420); only integrity-read via the header checksum. No traced field writes; gameplay writers, if any, are outside the traced cluster.
fields.evidence: Zero in both near-blank samples; no distinguishing code references. Reported as one span to avoid fabricating sub-fields.

fields.name: header_mutated_byte_0x68
fields.update_mechanism: Low byte of a 4-byte header field (0x68..0x6B, rest zero in both samples). Written as part of a 4-byte copy on factory reset; changed by an untraced gameplay writer between captures, with the header checksum following (+171 both). Presumed flushed via the header-only path FUN_080192a0.
fields.evidence: Only differing payload byte across the two .sav files (hexdump_and_diffs.txt and independent census agree); checksum lockstep proves checksummed payload status. Semantics (progress/score/counter) unproven; no progressed save in corpus.

fields.name: magic_1M2A
fields.update_mechanism: Copied from a reference pointer on factory reset only; compared byte-by-byte on every load. Mismatch -> full factory reset. Code-side struct offset prints as +0x68 vs file +0x6C (per-function _DAT_ base / EEPROM staging divergence, unresolved from supplied files).
fields.evidence: Bytes 31 4D 32 41 at file 0x6C in both samples; 4-byte compare in FUN_08019364 and 4-byte copy in FUN_08019420 in decompiled.c.

fields.name: header_reserved_0x70_0x75
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed by factory-reset memset; only integrity-read via the header checksum.
fields.evidence: Zero in both samples; no traced semantics.

fields.name: header_flag_byte_0
fields.update_mechanism: Set to 0xFF on factory reset (code offset +0x70); copied into a 1-byte global setting at boot by FUN_0801909c (reader side, no flush).
fields.evidence: FUN_08019420 stores 0xFF flag bytes and FUN_0801909c copies them out in decompiled.c; file bytes 0x76..0x77 are the only 0xFF pair inside the header in both samples. Setting semantics unknown.

fields.name: header_flag_byte_1
fields.update_mechanism: Set to 0xFF on factory reset (code offset +0x71); copied into a second 1-byte global setting at boot by FUN_0801909c.

fields.name: slot_payload_head
fields.update_mechanism: Per-slot span 0x78..0x95 pattern repeated at 0xB8/0xF8. Zeroed on reset; FUN_080190d4 transiently writes a u32 at slot+0, default u32s at slot+12/+16 and clears slot+28.. before FUN_08019078 memsets the first 0x3C bytes (reset path). Integrity-read only via the slot checksum.
fields.evidence: Zero in all 6 slot images; structured transient writes in FUN_080190d4 prove live-play structure exists but no progressed sample reveals it. Offset is slot 0; add 0x40 per slot.

fields.name: slot_index_byte
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_080190d4 writes the slot index (0/1/2) at slot+0x18, but FUN_08019078 then memsets the first 0x3C slot bytes in the reset path, erasing it. Offset is slot 0 (0x90); add 0x40 per slot (0xD0, 0x110).
fields.evidence: Explicit index store in FUN_080190d4 in decompiled.c; absence of 0x01/0x02 bytes in all sample slots confirms the reset-path erasure. Live-save retention unknown.

fields.name: slot_marker_0x20
fields.update_mechanism: Stored by FUN_08019078 on every slot (re)initialization (code offset slot+0x19; file offset slot+0x1E, divergence noted in report). Offset is slot 0 (0x96); add 0x40 per slot (0xD6, 0x116). Its value is the sole reason every stored slot checksum equals 0x0020.
fields.evidence: 0x20 store in FUN_08019078; byte 0x20 at slot+0x1E in all 6 slot images; slot sums verify to 0x0020 on both files.

fields.name: slot_payload_tail
fields.update_mechanism: Per-slot span slot+0x1F..+0x3B (inside the load-side 0x3C validation sum). Zeroed on reset. Offset is slot 0; add 0x40 per slot.
fields.evidence: Zero in all samples; no traced field semantics.

fields.name: slot_unvalidated_tail
fields.update_mechanism: Per-slot last 4 bytes (slot+0x3C..+0x3F). Included in the write-side slot sum (FUN_080193e0, length 0x40) but outside the load-side validation sum (FUN_080192c8, length 0x3C). Offset is slot 0; add 0x40 per slot.
fields.evidence: Length discrepancy read directly from FUN_080193e0 (0x40) vs FUN_080192c8 (0x3C) in decompiled.c; samples have zeros here so file bytes cannot discriminate. Fuzz target F5 in the report discriminates it.

fields.name: unused_tail_0x138
fields.update_mechanism: Never addressed: used image is exactly 0x138 bytes in every traced read/write. Erased EEPROM state.
fields.evidence: All 0xFF in both files; length constants 0x138/0x78 in FUN_080192c8/FUN_08019420/FUN_080192a0; no traced block index >= 39.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set header byte 0x68 to 0x01, 0xFF, and 0xAB (reproducing cap-01), repairing only the header checksum
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If it is gameplay progress, the corresponding HUD/menu value changes while slots stay blank; 0xAB reproduces cap-01 exactly. No change downgrades the field to inert UNKNOWN.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Flip the low byte of the stored header checksum (0x4F -> 0x4E) with no repair (negative control, replicates the pack probe)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Header validation fails in FUN_08019364 -> full factory reset -> blank save rewritten. Already confirmed by the pack cold-reload probe.
Signature compare in FUN_08019364 fails despite a valid checksum -> full factory reset, proving the magic gate is independent of the checksum gate.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Slot 0 marker 0x20 -> 0x00 and -> 0x21, repairing slot-0 checksum then header checksum
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Distinguishes marker semantics from arbitrary payload: an absent-slot UI or altered slot indicator implies marker meaning; a crash implies the byte feeds computation. Repeat at 0xD6/0x116 for slots 1/2.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Slot 0 byte +0x3C (file 0xB4) 0x00 -> 0x01 with NO checksum repair
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Discriminates the 0x40 (write, FUN_080193e0) vs 0x3C (load, FUN_080192c8) slot-sum length: loading successfully proves load sums only 0x3C bytes; a reset proves the effective length is 0x40.
No observable effect (never read or written). Any effect falsifies the 0x138 used-range model.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Header flag byte 0 (0x76) 0xFF -> 0x00, 0x01, 0x7F in turn, repairing the header checksum
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Byte is copied to a global at boot (FUN_0801909c); watch for a changed default setting (sound/language/difficulty class). Inert on all values -> spare flag.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Header flag byte 1 (0x77) 0xFF -> 0x00, 0x01, 0x7F in turn, repairing the header checksum
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Same boot-global mechanism as offset 118 for the second setting; compare which boot-visible default moves.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Slot 0 payload head (0x78) 0x00 -> 0x01, repairing slot-0 checksum then header checksum
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If slots are profiles, slot 0 becomes occupied/non-default in a select screen or shows a RAM-visible struct change after load; no delta implies unused payload head in blank-profile logic.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Flip one bit in the stored slot-0 checksum with no repair
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Header checksum (covering the table) fails first -> factory reset, confirming header-before-slot validation order; slot-only rejection would falsify the traced order.

open_questions: What gameplay function mutates header byte 0x68 (the only payload change between captures), and what does the value mean? No caller outside the save cluster was found; a progressed (non-blank) save corpus is needed.
Who calls the header-only flush FUN_080192a0? It has no callgraph caller and no textual caller in decompiled.c (presumed unrecovered indirect/tail jump).
What are the semantics of the two boot-restored flag bytes at file 0x76/0x77 (0xFF = reset value)? Fuzz targets at offsets 118/119 are designed to answer this.
Is the slot validation length really 0x3C on load vs 0x40 on write (FUN_080192c8 vs FUN_080193e0), leaving slot bytes +0x3C..+0x3F unvalidated? Fuzz target at offset 180 discriminates this.

What are the absolute RAM mirror addresses of the save struct and globals? Unrecoverable from the supplied files because decompiled.c only names unresolved _DAT_080xxxxx literal-pool symbols; only the EWRAM heap base (0x02000000) is known.

Why do several code-side struct offsets diverge from file offsets (signature +0x68 code vs +0x6C file; flags +0x70/+0x71 code vs +0x76/+0x77 file; slot marker +0x19 code vs +0x1E file; header-checksum store +0 code vs +0x06 file)? Per-function _DAT_ sub-struct bases and/or EEPROM bitstream staging are suspected; raw disassembly or literal-pool values would settle it.

Do the three 0x40-byte blocks function as player-selectable profiles, and does the slot-index byte written by FUN_080190d4 (+0x18) survive in live (non-reset) saves? Both samples are post-reset blank images.
What fills the 96-byte header payload span 0x08..0x67 and the slot payload spans in a progressed save? All are zero in this corpus.
